title: Orbit Intertwining Proposition for the Main Theorem
body_html:
Orbit Intertwining Proposition for the Main Theorem

Let \(\Sigma'=\#_{V,T'}(\Sigma)\), and let \(w\in V\otimes_D V'\) be the element produced by the construction of the target datum. In the generalized lattice model \(S(B_0)\), let \[ \Omega=K_M\cdot w+B_0 \] be the relevant \(K\times K'\)-orbit of the lattice coset, and let \(\eta_M\) be the product of the source and target \(K\)-types with the prescribed contragredient on the target side.

Then \[ \dim \operatorname{Hom}_{K_M}(\eta_M,S(B_0)_\Omega)=1. \] The proposition is proved by induction over the block decomposition of \(\Sigma\). It is the representation-theoretic bridge from the data-level construction to the nonzero theta lift in the main theorem.
